## ECHO 0.3.2 for Android

### No more empty band at the top
- The **"ECHO" title bar** that appeared at the top of the app is gone. It was the system's window title, shown by mistake since 0.2.0.
- On the **lyrics screen** the song now sits in the top row between the close and **Aa** buttons, so the lyrics start right under it. The song stays there when the buttons fade.

### Lyrics, refined
- **Crisp syllables.** Each word of the line being sung is now drawn on its own, set on the line's baseline. Joined syllables like "Ooh-ooh-ooh" no longer double up or look jagged.
- **Fully white once sung.** The soft edge of the fill is now a fixed width, so even short syllables end up fully white.
- **Held notes glow.** In Apple Music style, a word held for about a second or longer swells slightly and glows while it's held.
- **Clearer at a glance.** The unsung part of the line being sung is a little brighter than the lines around it, and the blur on lines further away is gentler.
- **Softer glow in Spicy Lyrics style.** The glow is free to spread without being cut off at the edge of its word.
- **Smoother fade-in.** A line without word timing fades in over a quarter of a second instead of snapping on.

### Installing
Download `ECHO-v0.3.2.apk` below. Uninstall 0.3.1 first, because each GitHub build gets a new signing key.
